_about: Hand-kept values for well-known special effects (procs and 'Use:' effects) that the stat parser cannot read. Values are rough averages over a fight (uptime x effect), in the same stats as weights.json. Items with other unknown effects are shown with a 'special effect' note and scored on their normal stats only. 'classes' limits an effect to some class ids (e.g. druid-only effects).
